_comment: Per-issue build/test commands for Amalgamator's verification (eval-only; the PR passes none). They run at the upstream repo root and build out of tree under /tmp/amalbuild/<hash of cwd>, so build products never enter the patch. nginx has none: the patched regex-capture code only compiles with PCRE1, which EL10 does not ship, so a build would not exercise the fix.

RHEL-112546.test: B=/tmp/amalbuild/$(pwd | md5sum | cut -c1-12); cmake -S . -B "$B" -Dtiff-docs=OFF >/dev/null && cmake --build "$B" -j8 && ctest --test-dir "$B" -j8 --output-on-failure

RHEL-114618.build: B=/tmp/amalbuild/$(pwd | md5sum | cut -c1-12); rm -rf "$B" && mkdir -p "$B" && cp -a expat/. "$B"/ && cd "$B" && ./buildconf.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./configure --without-docbook >/dev/null && make -j8 -C lib >/dev/null && make -j8 -C xmlwf >/dev/null
RHEL-114618.test: B=/tmp/amalbuild/$(pwd | md5sum | cut -c1-12); rm -rf "$B" && mkdir -p "$B" && cp -a expat/. "$B"/ && cd "$B" && ./buildconf.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./configure --without-docbook >/dev/null && make -j8 -C lib >/dev/null && make -j8 -C xmlwf >/dev/null && make -j8 -C tests check
